def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    initial_equity_index = 100.0
    fixed_rate = 0.03
    notional_amount = 100_000_000.0
    payment_frequency = 4

    fixed_payment = (fixed_rate * notional_amount) / payment_frequency

    # Present value factors for the three remaining quarterly payments
    present_value_factors = [0.997506, 0.992556, 0.985222]

    # The equity settlement occurs at the swap expiry
    expiry_present_value_factor = present_value_factors[-1]

    # Calculate the present value of the remaining fixed-leg payments
    fixed_leg_present_value = fixed_payment * sum(present_value_factors)

    # At zero value, the present value of the equity leg equals the fixed leg
    required_equity_return = fixed_leg_present_value / (
        notional_amount * expiry_present_value_factor
    )

    equity_index_level = initial_equity_index * (1 + required_equity_return)

    # Return the index level rounded to three decimal places
    return round(equity_index_level, 3)
